verdict.rationale: Cactus documents a public REST API at /llms/api covering training-data generation (POST /generations), tool-schema generation (POST /tool_schemas), a reserve/PUT/complete upload flow, training parameters such as max_depth, and GET /billing, plus unauthenticated GET /v1/plans. An OpenAPI spec is published at /v1/openapi.json, and the docs say API-key-driven use from CLI, Python or a coding agent is supported. The probe's 404s on root-level OpenAPI paths do not contradict the /v1 spec location. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the hosted REST API, and a probe confirming the /v1/openapi.json spec actually resolves.
